title: Newsletter Archive

Newsletter Archive

Newsletter #0041

9 February 2025

Hello EO-Masters!

This time I have some disappointing news for you. But not too much. This is the last issue of my newsletter. But not the last time I'm providing news to you.

The newsletter received a good uptake at the beginning but then stalled. Not many new users have signed up for it.

Collecting and writing the news is a bit of an effort, and I want to put this effort into other things, like the software where it has more value for you.

If you are still interested in the latest news, you can follow me on social media. But you are already doing it, don't you?
There I will still inform about the latest news I find interesting and about the latest developments of EOMasters.
